Usage: belz cache [flags] <uuid...>
       belz cache --all --yes [--type <TYPE>]

Invalidate server-side cache entries for the active environment. Every call is
POSTed to BOTH /rest/api/cache/invalidate and /rest/api/automations/cache/invalidate
with body {"uuids":[...],"type":"<TYPE>"}; it succeeds if any route returns 2xx,
and each route's result is reported.

An invalidate with no UUIDs flushes the ENTIRE cache of that type for the whole
organisation, so it is refused unless both --all and --yes are passed.

Args:
  <uuid...>           One or more cache entry UUIDs (e.g. method/chain UUIDs).

Flags:
  --type <TYPE>       Cache type to invalidate. (default: AUTOMATION)
  --all               Flush every entry of --type (org-wide). Requires --yes.
  --yes, -y           Confirm an --all flush.
  --help, -h          Show this help message.

Global Flags:
  --env <name>        Environment to operate on. (default: nsm-dev)
                      Also accepts --env=<name> or -e <name>.
  --llm               Output structured JSON envelope for scripting/LLM use.
  -v, --verbose       Verbose request logging.

Examples:
  # Invalidate three automation cache entries on the active env
  belz cache 44014c3707d6b6d8ae848839a1c8d1e7 47425344e088690ff89aa8f1e092c867 4a1d686b87f93b1519f2b61393d4ed7a

  # Same, against nsm-qa
  belz cache --env nsm-qa <uuid> <uuid>

  # Wipe the entire AUTOMATION cache on nsm-uat (org-wide; use with care)
  belz cache --env nsm-uat --all --yes

  # Invalidate by a non-default type
  belz cache --type PAGE <uuid>
